title: Mechanical Design Engineer II (Onsite)
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact:
Dedrone stands out as the global leader in airspace defense technology and counter UAS solutions. Engineering at Dedrone is tasked with delivering innovative solutions and products to maintain our position on the cutting-edge of innovation.

Mechanical Engineers at Dedrone have full design ownership over next generation cUAS technology from conceptualization through production, who's work is highly visible to even the most senior executives. our passionate leadership and cross-functional collaboration with product managers, electrical engineers, industrial designers, and manufacturing teams is vital to the success of the team and ensuring the safety of the general public for generations to come.

This role emphasizes mechanical design, thermal analysis, prototyping, and system integration. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in CAD modeling, structural optimization, and hands-on prototyping, with a focus on creating durable and high-performance designs for diverse operational environments.

Location: Onsite at our offices in Sterling, VA
What You'll Do:

• Drive innovative product development from conceptualization through manufacturing, ensuring designs meet durability and reliability standards.

• Utilize creative problem solving skills to lead ideation of new product architectural concepts for subsystem and system level designs

• Construct and analyze high fidelity proof-of-concept prototypes

• Perform detailed mechanical analysis to ensure proper function through FEA, tolerance analysis, testing, and other exploratory means

• Collaborate regularly with both domestic and international stakeholders

• Work autonomously and collaboratively in an empowering and fast-paced environment

• Hone your engineering expertise in a dynamic learning environment focused on personal and professional development

• Rigorously document and manage design specifications, production processes, and compliance requirements.

What You Bring:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field

• Proven experience in mechanical design and system integration, preferably in industries involving advanced hardware systems.

• Proficiency in CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Fusion 360) for 3D modeling and detailed engineering drawings.

• Hands-on experience with prototyping tools and fabrication equipment (e.g., drills, bandsaws, 3D printers).

• Knowledge of embedded systems, microcontrollers (e.g., ESP32, Arduino), and single-board computers (e.g., Raspberry Pi).

• Strong understanding of engineering principles, including heat transfer, EMI, and shock/vibration.

• Experience with simulation tools for thermal and structural analysis.

• Familiarity with MIL STDs and designing for harsh environments.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to identify and resolve technical challenges.

• Excellent communication skills to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and present complex ideas.

• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with high levels of ambiguity.

Work Location
This role is based out of either our Sterling, VA office, and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. title: Paid Social Specialist
description:
Releaf Dispensary Ltd is a pioneering medical cannabis clinic committed to providing high-quality, safe, and effective cannabis-based products. Headquartered in the UK, we aim to enhance the quality of life for our patients through cutting-edge solutions and outstanding patient service. We are a fast-growing team of passionate professionals on a mission to put patients back in control of their health journey - we have seen first-hand how alternative treatments can change lives.
We are proud to be a certified B Corp - the first medicinal cannabis clinic in the world to achieve this recognition - reflecting our commitment to the highest standards of social and environmental responsibility.
The role
You will report into the Head of Performance Marketing and work closely with our Paid Search Specialist. You’ll own and scale our paid social programme across Meta and other social channels.
Meta is our core paid social channel and where the majority of budget sits - this role lives in Ads Manager daily, managing significant spend against real performance targets. Beyond that, we want someone who can help us test and build out other platforms as we grow.
This is an operational role, not an oversight role. You'll be building campaigns, briefing and testing creative, managing budgets, reading the data and making decisions based on this. You'll be doing it in a category where advertising is tightly regulated, so accuracy and compliance matter as much as performance.
Main Responsibilities

• Own day-to-day management of Meta paid social activity - campaign structure, audiences, budgets, bidding, placements and creative rotation across Facebook and Instagram.

• Manage and pace significant monthly spend against CPA and volume targets, with clear forecasting and in-month course correction.

• Run a continuous creative testing roadmap: hooks, formats, angles, static vs video, UGC, landing page pairings.

• Brief creative clearly and specifically - you'll know what you want to test and why, and you'll be able to tell the design team what good looks like.

• Own the technical setup: pixel and Conversions API, event configuration, catalogue and audience management, and troubleshooting when signal quality drops.

• Work within advertising policy and regulatory restrictions specific to our sector - making sure every ad, asset and landing page is compliant before it goes live, and managing rejections, restrictions and appeals when they happen.

• Own the relationship with Meta's account and support teams, and get the most out of betas and alpha access.

• Test, scale or sunset activity on other platforms such as TikTok or Pinterest based on evidence

• Build the business case for new channel investment and run those tests properly, with clean measurement and a clear read.

• Own paid social reporting: weekly performance, monthly business reviews and ad hoc deep dives for leadership.

• Analyse performance end to end in GA4 alongside platform data, and be able to explain the discrepancies confidently rather than picking whichever number looks best.

• Use incrementality testing, geo tests, holdouts or lift studies to establish what paid social is genuinely delivering.

• Feed insight back into creative, landing pages and offers - you'll be expected to have a point of view on what should change and why.

What we're looking for
Essential

• Strong, demonstrable, hands-on Meta paid social experience - this is the core of the role.

• Proven track record managing significant paid social budgets with direct accountability for performance.

• Genuine creative instinct: you can spot why an ad is or isn't working and turn that into the next test.

• Comfortable with measurement - platform reporting, GA4, and the gap between the two.

• Confident with numbers: spreadsheets, forecasting, spotting anomalies quickly.

• Able to work independently and prioritise. This is a hands-on role with real ownership.

title: Backend & Data Engineer
description:
Backend & Data Engineer - GIS / Photogrammetry

Remote | Full-time

About the Project

Our client is a U.S.-based technology company working with large-scale geospatial data and imagery.

We are looking for an experienced Backend & Data Engineer to join their data team, with an expected start as soon as possible.

This role combines software engineering, backend development, and data processing with specialized hands-on experience in GIS, photogrammetry, and geospatial imagery processing.

The engineer will work daily with core processing systems and large-scale imagery captured from drones (UAVs), fixed-wing aircraft, and/or high-resolution satellite sources.

The ideal candidate has strong Python skills and proven hands-on experience processing geospatial imagery using relevant tools and libraries such as GDAL, Agisoft Metashape, Pix4D, or similar technologies.

Strong AWS experience is a significant plus.

Responsibilities

• Develop, maintain, and support backend and data-processing systems using Python.
• Work with core processing systems and large-scale geospatial imagery.
• Process imagery captured from drones/UAVs, fixed-wing aircraft, and/or high-resolution satellites.
• Build and maintain reliable data-processing workflows and pipelines.
• Apply hands-on GIS and photogrammetry expertise to geospatial imagery-processing workflows.
• Work with geospatial processing tools and libraries such as GDAL, Agisoft Metashape, Pix4D, or similar technologies.
• Process, transform, and manage large volumes of geospatial data and imagery.
• Collaborate with engineering and data team members to develop and improve processing solutions.
• Troubleshoot backend, data-processing, and imagery-processing issues.
• Support the scalability, reliability, and performance of systems handling large-scale geospatial data.
• Contribute to the continued improvement of engineering and data-processing practices.

Requirements

• Strong professional experience in software engineering, backend engineering, and/or data engineering.

• Strong proficiency in Python.

• Hands-on professional experience with GIS and geospatial data processing.
• Hands-on experience with photogrammetry and imagery processing.
• Proven experience processing imagery from at least one of the following sources:

• Drones / UAVs

• Fixed-wing aircraft

• High-resolution satellite imagery
• Practical experience with geospatial and photogrammetry tools or libraries such as GDAL, Agisoft Metashape, Pix4D, or similar technologies.
• Experience developing or maintaining data-processing systems, workflows, or pipelines.
• Ability to work with large-scale datasets and imagery-processing workflows.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work effectively within a collaborative engineering environment.
• Availability to join the project as soon as possible.

Nice to Have

• Strong hands-on experience with AWS.

• Experience building or supporting cloud-based data-processing systems.
• Experience working with large-scale geospatial imagery-processing environments.
• Experience optimizing data pipelines or processing systems for performance and scalability.
• Previous experience working with distributed engineering teams.

title: Product Manager/ Product Owner
description:
🌟 About Mapal
We are a fast-growing B2B SaaS company transforming how hospitality businesses operate through technology. Mapal Group provides an integrated platform that helps restaurants, hotels, and contract catering brands optimize operations, empower their teams, and scale efficiently. Operating across Europe, the UK, and LATAM, we continue to expand our footprint as we accelerate our growth.
💡 Our Culture
Our culture is shaped by six core values: Commitment, Customer Obsession, One Team, Ownership, Resilience, and Think Big. These values drive everything we do, from how we support our customers to how we work together as a team. We seek individuals who embody these values, bringing passion and creativity to their work, taking ownership of their contributions, and embracing collaboration and innovation to achieve ambitious goals.
🎯 Role Overview
We’re looking for a Product Manager with a strong analytical mindset to join our team at Mapal and take ownership of Mapal Operating System (MoS) - the core platform that connects and powers all Mapal products.
MoS acts as the source of truth for our global ecosystem: it hosts shared data, global services, and cross-product functionalities that make the entire Mapal suite work seamlessly together. This role is ideal for someone who understands technology deeply and enjoys transforming technical foundations into scalable, valuable product experiences.
🛠 Key Responsabilities
You will define and drive the product strategy for MoS, ensuring it provides a robust, unified backbone for all Mapal applications. You’ll collaborate with engineering to design scalable services and APIs, with other product teams to define shared functionalities, and with data and operations to ensure MoS evolves as a true global platform.

• Define and own the product vision and roadmap for MoS.

• Partner with engineering to translate architectural and infrastructure needs into clear product goals and deliverables.

• Ensure data consistency and interoperability across all Mapal products.

• Drive the development of shared services (notifications, authentication, integrations, analytics, etc.) that can be reused across the ecosystem.

• Collaborate with other Product Managers to identify and prioritize cross-product functionalities that should live in MoS.

• Establish metrics and dashboards to measure the adoption, stability, and performance of MoS.

Requirements
✅ Qualifications

• Experience in product management within a SaaS or platform-based environment.

• Solid understanding of APIs, system architecture, and data modeling .

• Ability to translate complex concepts into clear product narratives.

• Proven collaboration skills with engineering and cross-functional teams.

• Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

• A passion for building the invisible layers that make complex ecosystems work smoothly.

At Mapal, we’re building the technology that powers hospitality worldwide. As the Product Manager for MoS, you’ll shape the foundation on which all our products depend - ensuring consistency, scalability, and global impact. This is a unique opportunity to work on the connective tissue of an entire platform and to influence how thousands of businesses experience Mapal every day.
Equal Employment Opportunity
At Mapal, we believe our differences make us stronger. We’re proud to offer equal opportunities to everyone, no matter your background, identity, or life experience. What matters most to us is your talent, your passion, and the ideas you bring to our team. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and supported. In line with applicable European regulations, we provide reasonable accommodations for candidates and employees with disabilities. If you require any assistance during the application or interview process, please inform the Talent Acquisition team.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. title: Technical Sales Engineer
description:
Eaton ’s Bussmann Division is currently seeking a Technical Sales Engineer. This is a remote position based in the Houston, TX area. Travel up to 40% will be required.
Reporting to the Manager of Field Application Engineering, the role will act as the subject matter expert on overcurrent protection (fuses and fuse accessories) in the Houston region (including SE Louisiana and Mississippi) and develop appropriate materials, articles and presentations and other training aids to achieve the desired sales goals.
The Technical Sales Engineer creates and manages demand for Bussmann series products by driving and influencing specifications at the end customer, which includes consulting engineers, design-build contractors, electrical inspectors and original equipment manufacturers (OEMs). Responsibilities include influencing targeted state and local jurisdictions to adopt the latest version of the National Electrical Code (NEC) and working with electrical inspectors to help enforce NEC and Underwriters Laboratories (UL) requirements that help to increase safety and ultimately sales of Bussmann series products.
In this role you will:
• Influence consulting engineers, design-build contractors, end users, OEMs and electrical design engineers on the benefits of specifying and utilizing Bussmann series products.
• Train and assist electrical inspectors on the benefits of enforcing NEC sections that are most beneficial for creating demand for Bussmann series products.
• Assist UL inspectors on the benefits of enforcing portions of UL standards that are most beneficial for creating demand for Bussmann series products.
• Train customers on the benefits and application of Bussmann series products related to the proper application per the National Electrical Code.
• Influence NFPA, IEEE, IAEI, IBEW, NECA, and NJATC members and state / local electrical code members to vote for Division-friendly changes and proposals that create demand for Division products.
• Develop specification-oriented sales materials, articles and presentations as appropriate.
• Identify gaps in the product offering and potential new products and applications.
• Provide pre-sale and value-add post sale support to OEMs on product applications.
• Drive specifications at end users that “pull through” Bussmann series products at OEMs that support the end user.
• Provide technical product training and updates to both internal and external customers.
• Establish as the subject matter expert or the “go-to” resource on overcurrent protection in the territory and develop appropriate materials, articles and presentations and other training aids to achieve the desired sales goals.
• Accumulates and fosters technical knowledge to stay on the cutting edge of expertise.
• Coordinates activities with the commercial sales team in the territory and is a strong collaborator.

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering from an accredited institution

We are looking for an ML Software Engineer to join the Multi-Embodiment Generalist Agent (MEGA) team within Wayve Science as a founding member. MEGA is building foundation models for general-purpose robots: models that learn from large-scale video, language, and robot-interaction data, then generalize across tasks and embodiments, including mobile manipulators, dual-arm platforms, and humanoids. Our aim is to build agents that can perceive, reason about, and act reliably in the physical world. You will design and build the software systems that enable MEGA’s machine learning research. The role sits close to the models and data. You will work with large-scale video and robotics datasets, modern ML frameworks, and increasingly large models, building systems that remain reliable and maintainable as the research program grows. - Identify and resolve performance, reliability, and usability bottlenecks across ML workflows.

- Build and maintain infrastructure that supports multiple researchers and ML projects without unnecessarily slowing down iteration.

title: Principal Product Manager, Security
description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

Security isn't a feature at 1Password. It is the product. We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to shape security strategy across the company, working with Security Engineering, who hold one of the highest technical bars in the industry, and with the product teams building everything our customers touch.

You'll be the bridge. You'll understand cryptographic and architectural detail well enough to earn the trust of our security engineers, and you'll translate what matters into clear priorities for feature teams. Just as importantly, you'll bring a deep respect for the customer: a security control nobody can stand to use makes everyone less safe. You'll help us find the design that's both rigorous and usable, and have the credibility to say so in a room full of experts

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Partner with product teams on security early. Work with PMs and feature teams to understand their upcoming roadmaps, identify security requirements and threat-model implications before designs are locked, and make sure those needs are visible, prioritized, and resourced.

- Align Security Engineering with product strategy. Translate feature-team needs into prioritized security work, and make Security Engineering's priorities legible to the rest of the company so tradeoffs are made in the open.

- Own an independent security roadmap. Set direction for platform-level security investments, such as key management and recovery, the cryptographic foundations of our zero-knowledge architecture, authentication, and our long-term readiness for post-quantum cryptography.

- Lead our strategy for the AI era. Define how 1Password approaches agentic access to credentials, secrets for non-human identities and AI agents, and the trust models emerging around tools and protocols like MCP.

- Balance risk and usability with evidence. Help security engineers weigh real-world risk against user friction, using adoption, support, and telemetry data alongside threat models. Shipping with accepted, documented residual risk is sometimes the right call, and you'll help us make and defend those decisions.

- Represent 1Password to the security community. Engage with security researchers and our bug bounty program, speak at conferences, and contribute to the wider conversation about where credential security is heading.

- Raise the bar for product work. Coach PMs on security thinking, challenge assumptions constructively, and set the standard for how security-critical product work gets done.

title: Product Analyst
description:
This is a remote position.

Role overview Our client is an Australian technology company whose AI voice agent platform answers and handles phone calls for businesses in Australia and New Zealand. As a Product Analyst , your responsibility is to research the AI voice agent market and turn it into clear, build-ready feature documents for our client's development team. This role is the bridge between the market and the product. You will study what competitors offer, analyse what the platform should build next, and write specifications the CTO can act on. The Founder & CEO makes final decisions on what gets built. Business owners create their own AI agents that can answer questions, book appointments, collect caller details, send SMS messages and transfer calls to staff. The platform is fully self-serve: customers set up and manage their agents, and handle any escalated calls themselves. The platform is built on its own technology stack using leading speech and language AI models, and is designed to work across industries.
Key Responsibilities
Market and competitor research

• Identify and track AI voice agent and call-handling platforms, globally and in Australia and New Zealand.

• Sign up for competitor free trials, build test agents and call demo numbers to experience their products first-hand.

• Monitor competitor feature releases, pricing changes, integrations and new market entrants.

Feature analysis

• Break down how competitors design and deliver specific features, including user flows, settings and limitations.

• Assess which features are standard expectations and which could set the platform apart.

• Research third-party integrations (CRMs, calendars, booking systems, helpdesks) and how they connect to voice agent platforms.

Feature documentation

• Write clear, structured feature specification documents using the client's standard format.

• Present feature documents to the Founder & CEO for review and approval.

• Hand approved specifications to the CTO and answer the development team's questions about them.

• Keep a prioritised feature backlog up to date.

Platform insight

• Review anonymised call transcripts and recordings to spot where agents struggle or callers get confused.

• Analyse platform usage data, such as feature adoption and drop-off during agent setup.

• Review support tickets and cancellation feedback for recurring issues and feature requests.

Product quality

• Test new features once built against the approved specification and report gaps.

• Help maintain product documentation and help-centre content for new features.

Requirements

Essential

• 1-3 years in a product analyst, business analyst, QA or similar role at a software or SaaS company.

• Excellent written English, with the ability to write clear, structured documents for both business and technical readers.

• Strong research and analytical skills, with a habit of testing products hands-on rather than relying on marketing pages.

• Ability to understand software features and user flows, and explain them simply.

• Confident using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT for research, analysis and drafting.

• Organised and self-directed, able to manage several research topics at once and meet agreed deadlines.

• Reliable home internet and a quiet workspace suitable for remote work.

Desirable

• Familiarity with AI voice agents, chatbots or conversational AI products.

• Basic understanding of APIs and how software integrations work.

description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Role Summary

The Global Head of Sanctions owns the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of Nubank's global sanctions compliance program across every market the company serves or plans to enter. This includes compliance with U.S. sanctions administered by OFAC, as well as EU, UN, UK OFSI, and other applicable regimes. Based in Tysons, VA - close to Washington, D.C.- this leader is Nubank's principal voice on sanctions matters with U.S. regulators and acts as the central point of accountability for sanctions risk as the company expands beyond Latin America. The role combines deep technical sanctions expertise with the people leadership and stakeholder management needed to run a program across multiple countries, languages, and regulatory regimes.

Key Responsibilities

- Design, own, and continuously enhance Nubank's global sanctions policy framework, ensuring alignment with OFAC, EU, UN, and other relevant sanctions regimes across all current and future markets.

- Direct the end-to-end sanctions screening program, including customer (onboarding and ongoing) screening, transaction and payments screening, and the systems, vendors, and models that power them.

- Oversee watchlist and reference data management, including list ingestion, update cadence, and screening logic tuning to balance detection effectiveness against false-positive rates.

- Lead investigation and escalation of potential and true sanctions hits, including disposition decisions, blocked and rejected transaction handling, and required regulatory filings and reporting.

- Serve as Nubank's primary interface with OFAC, Treasury, and other regulators on sanctions matters, including managing examinations, inquiries, and voluntary self-disclosures where applicable.

- Advise business, product, and partnerships teams on sanctions risk in new products, markets, customer segments, and third-party relationships before launch.

- Monitor geopolitical and regulatory developments and translate them into timely program updates.

- Coordinate independent testing, internal audit, and regulatory examinations of the sanctions program, and drive remediation of identified gaps.

- Own sanctions training and awareness programs for employees, contractors, and relevant third parties across the organization.

Qualifications

Required Professional Experience & Education:

- 10+ years of progressive experience in sanctions compliance or broader financial crimes compliance within financial services.

- Deep, current knowledge of OFAC regulations and sanctions programs, with working familiarity with EU, UN, and UK OFSI regimes.

- Experience building, scaling, or materially uplifting a sanctions program in a high-growth, regulated, or fintech environment.

- Demonstrated people leadership, including managing distributed or multi-country teams.

- Strong track record of stakeholder management with regulators, executives, and the Board.

- Bachelor's degree required.

- Willingness to be based in or relocate to Virginia with periodic travel to Brazil and other Latin American offices.

Prefered Professional Experience:

- Experience at a global or multi-jurisdictional bank, payments company, or fintech operating across multiple regulatory regimes.

- CAMS or equivalent financial crimes compliance certification.

- Direct experience managing OFAC examinations, voluntary self-disclosures, or sanctions-related enforcement matters.

- Familiarity with sancti

description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems - robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

You'll report to the Creative Director of Product Marketing.

Your work will directly shape how people discover, understand, and adopt Runway's products. You'll partner closely with product marketing, growth, design, and product teams - and you'll be measured on clarity, speed, and impact.

- Partner with product marketing on positioning, messaging frameworks, and go-to-market copy for new releases

- Collaborate with design and product teams to shape the in-product writing experience

- Write and iterate on A/B test variants across landing pages, emails, and ads

- Translate complex, technical product capabilities into clear, compelling language for a range of audiences

- Maintain consistency in product voice and terminology across all touchpoints

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- 4+ years of experience in product copywriting, growth marketing or a related writing role at a tech or SaaS company

- A portfolio that shows range across performance marketing, product copy and in-product writing - not just brand campaigns

- Strong instinct for conversion-oriented writing - you think in terms of clarity, action, and outcomes

- Experience writing in-product copy (onboarding, feature education, UX microcopy) alongside marketing copy

- Comfort working with data - you can look at test results, funnel metrics and engagement data and know what to write next

- Experience partnering with product, design, and growth teams in a fast-moving environment

- Ability to context-switch across multiple launches and workstreams without losing quality

- Experience in AI, creative tools, or developer-adjacent products is a strong plus

title: AI Engineer
description:
Jeeves is the stablecoin-native banking platform for global enterprises. Thousands of companies across 35 countries run their corporate cards, payments, treasury and spend on one platform, with more than $5B in annualized volume, payouts to 190 countries, and one of the fastest-growing stablecoin payment networks in the world. BMW, H&M, Lululemon, Burger King, Kavak and XP are among them, and more than 80% of customers use multiple Jeeves products.
We chose hard problems on purpose.
We hire for one thing: relentlessness. A strong motor that keeps going when the problem has no playbook. You'll know in your first week if Jeeves is right for you. For the right people, it's the steepest learning curve of your career.
Jeeves has raised more than $400 million in equity funding from Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Coinbase Ventures, GIC, AllianceBernstein, CoinFund and others.
If you want to rebuild how money moves across borders, come build it with us.
Finance teams still spend most of their week on manual work: reading invoices and receipts, matching transactions, checking spend against policy, chasing approvals, and closing the books across several countries and currencies. AI can now do much of that work reliably, and Jeeves is building it into the core of our platform. That only matters if it works in production, with real money, for real customers.
As an AI Engineer at Jeeves , you will own whole workflows from end to end, not individual features. For example, you might own everything that happens between an invoice arriving and a payment going out: document extraction, matching, policy checks, approval routing, posting to the customer's ERP, and the evaluation and monitoring that tell us it's working. You'll decide how to build it, ship it, measure it, and keep improving it. You'll work closely with Product, Backend Engineering, and our customers' finance teams, but you won't wait for someone to hand you a spec.
This is a senior, hands-on role for people who are AI-native in how they work. You use coding agents and AI tools every day to move faster, and you know where they fall short. It isn't a research role, and it isn't a role for someone who wants a narrow, well-defined ticket queue.
Location: This role is remote or hybrid based out of Bogotá, Colombia, and is a full-time remote position where it is also possible to come into our office in the Parque de la 93 area on a flexible schedule.
What You'll Do:

Own AI Workflows End to End

• Take a finance workflow (for example invoice-to-payment, expense review, or transaction reconciliation) and own it from problem definition through production and ongoing improvement

• Design agentic and LLM-based systems that combine extraction, retrieval, reasoning, and tool use to complete multi-step work, with clear human-in-the-loop points for high-value financial decisions

• Write the design docs, make the build-vs-buy and model choices, and set the success metrics for each workflow you own

• Talk directly with customers and internal finance users to understand where the workflow breaks today and what "done" looks like

Build Reliable AI in Production

• Build production-grade LLM pipelines: prompt and context design, structured outputs, validation, fallbacks, and confidence scoring

• Design retrieval and RAG components (chunking, embeddings, vector search, re-ranking) where a workflow needs grounding in customer documents or policies

• Integrate AI services cleanly with Jeeves 's backend: clear API contracts, retries, graceful degradation, and per-customer data isolation

• Manage cost and latency across models, choosing the right model for each step

Measure, Monitor, and Improve

• Build evaluation sets and automated evals for every workflow you own, and use them to catch regressions when prompts, models, or data change

• Instrument AI components with logging, tracing, dashboards, and alerts so you know when quality drops before a customer does

Over 50,000 customers globally trust our end-to-end, cloud-driven networking solutions. They rely on our top-rated services and support to accelerate their digital transformation efforts and deliver unprecedented progress.
Become part of something big with Extreme! As a global networking leader, learn why there is no better time to join the Extreme team.
Position details
Title of position:  Staff Forward Deployed Engineer
Position type: Full time - Hybrid
Location:  Seattle, WA
Position reports to: Director of Software Systems Engineering
Application deadline: Applications are being accepted on a rolling basis and this posting will remain open until filled.
Work authorization: We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa, including H-1B visas, at this time 
Scope:
Are you energized by solving complex, high-impact problems directly with customers? Do you want to turn emerging technologies in intelligent networking, generative AI, agentic systems, automation, and cloud platforms into production solutions? Do you want what you build and learn in the field to help shape capabilities that benefit customers at scale?
Then come advance with us.
About the Position
Forward Deployed Engineers at Extreme are software engineers who work directly with strategic customers to jointly design, build, validate, and deploy solutions to complex business and technical problems using Extreme's products and platforms.
FDEs operate in real customer environments and own technical outcomes from discovery and solution design through implementation, deployment, and production readiness. The solutions they build must meet demanding requirements for scalability, security, reliability, observability, and operational safety.
This is a deeply technical and hands-on engineering organization. FDEs work directly with customers to understand complex problems and design, build, deploy, and stabilize production solutions using Extreme's products and platforms. They write production software, solve complex systems and integration problems, and own technical outcomes from solution design through production readiness. FDEs also identify platform gaps and define new feature requirements, working with Product teams to incorporate recurring customer needs into Extreme's products and platforms.
About the Role
As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you will be the technical lead for complex customer engagements, owning solutions from discovery and architecture through implementation, deployment, and production readiness.
You will work side by side with customer engineering teams to understand their environment, data, systems, workflows, and technical constraints and turn complex or ambiguous problems into production solutions. Depending on the engagement, these solutions may include agents, applications, integrations, data connectors, APIs, tools, skills, workflows, automation, and supporting infrastructure.
You will remain deeply hands-on while providing technical leadership to other engineers on the engagement. You will also identify reusable patterns and platform gaps that emerge from customer work and help turn those learnings into capabilities that can benefit customers beyond a single engagement.

This is not a "run our marketing" role. There is no existing playbook to execute, no team to manage, and no agency doing the heavy lifting. You will be the first dedicated marketing hire at Mission Inbox . You will build the strategy, own the execution, and eventually manage the team as channels mature and headcount follows performance.
The right person sees this as the defining chapter of their career - a rare chance to build a full marketing function at a technical infrastructure company with real revenue, real customers, and real upside.Our Team is distributed all over the world, we welcome talent, no matter their geography, ethnicity or religion.

Days 31-60: First webinar live. First nurture sequence running. Paid campaigns optimized with real data. First pipeline attribution report presented to CEO.

title: Sales Operations AI Research Contributor
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Aptura is looking for Subject Matter Experts from sales or revenue operations, supporting B2B sales teams, who build ARR waterfalls, commission models and territory plans in Excel. You have used AI tools on your own work and been frustrated by the mistakes they make. You will turn that experience into realistic Excel tasks that test how well AI does the work of a Sales Ops Analyst.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Writing realistic Excel tasks drawn from your own work: extending existing models, fixing broken ones and building from a brief

- Working through each task yourself so there is a clear, correct answer

- Writing yes-or-no criteria precise enough that a grader can mark any attempt against them

NECESSARY QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years in sales operations, revenue operations or SaaS finance, covering pipeline, bookings, quota and compensation for B2B sales teams

- Deep hands-on Excel: ARR waterfalls, commission calculators, nested formulas, multi-criteria lookups and pivot tables

- Strong written English communication skills.

- Attention to detail, and willingness to learn concepts in AI and Evals

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

- Start Date : Immediate

- Duration: Approximately 4-6 weeks

- Payment: task-based. Experts who complete their first task within the required timeline will then be qualified to do multiple tasks for the remainder of the project.

CONTRACT AND PAYMENT TERMS

- You will be engaged as an independent contractor.

- This is a fully remote role that can be completed on your own schedule.

- Projects can be extended, shortened, or concluded early depending on needs and performance.

- Your work at Aptura will not involve access to confidential or proprietary information from any employer, client, or institution.

- Payments will be weekly following task completion.

GETTING STARTED

- Apply with your details and CV. Choose an available 30-minute group walkthrough call.

- Attend the walkthrough and create one original task from your own work. Submit the brief, the actual input workbook(s) needed to complete it. Input-file uploads are compulsory.

- Write the brief yourself. Input workbooks must also be human-built. Use real data that has been sanitised, or public data with the source named. No AI usage allowed.

- We run your task against current frontier AI models. If the models get it wrong, you then write a detailed yes-or-no rubric, and a reviewer signs off on the task with you.

- Completing onboarding does not guarantee a job offer; selection remains subject to written approval of the task proposal.

ABOUT APTURA

Aptura is an applied AI and data company working with frontier labs to train AI systems on real professional work. We do this by building high-quality evaluation and training environments that teach AI agents to produce work that can be used in daily workflows.

description: About Kernel Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this? Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier. Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust. Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. title: Hardwareingenieur - Elektronik
description: About pplwise pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics. About our client: Filics Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Senior Electrical Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will design the electronics at the core of the next generation of robots. About the role This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly. Filics doesn’t just use off-the-shelf components. It builds its own custom IP. The robots run on advanced boards that cover a wide range of electrical engineering. On one end is high power, such as battery and motor controllers. On the other end are high-speed interfaces like PCIe, USB and MIPI CSI. The real challenge is making all these subsystems work together as one system. Many of these problems have no textbook solution. Solving them takes solid experience, a deep understanding of the physics and a creative mind. The EE team is small, and the robot is far from finished. You’ll own your boards end to end : requirements, system design, schematic, layout, design review, sourcing, manufacturing, testing and validation. You’ll keep owning them for as long as they’re in prod

title: Senior Data Scientist, People Analytics & Research
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:
People Analytics & Research is a strong team of Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Analysts. Our work is highly sought-after, and impacts stakeholders in our People function, and across the business. In this role, you'll take on some of the hardest questions about Airbnb 's workforce - how we recruit, pay, develop, and retain our people - partnering with leaders across Recruiting, Compensation, Talent, and the wider business to turn rigorous analysis into decisions they act on.
The Difference You Will Make:
The People Analytics & Research team is looking for an experienced Data Scientist to lead and/or contribute to our most important research - applying causal inference and quasi-experimental methods to high-stakes people questions: how we recruit, hire, promote, and retain a best-in-class workforce; how we keep key company processes fair; and how work itself is changing. Employee listening and survey analysis are part of the mix, but the heart of the role is rigorous inferential research on observational people data. The role is highly cross-functional, and you will partner with Recruiting, Talent Leaders, Compensation, Legal, and Diversity & Belonging. We need a Data Scientist with a proven track record of translating data into insight and action.
If you have a proven background in this field and are excited to help build Airbnb ’s community, we want to hear from you.
A Typical Day:

• Collaborate with partners and stakeholders to understand people-related business problems, and gather relevant people data to analyze

• Utilize appropriate statistical models and data science methodologies to gain insights, explain, or predict a wide variety of people-related processes, such as recruiting and hiring, promotion, retention, pay equity, productivity, and organizational effectiveness, among others

• Translate data and insights into meaningful visualizations and stories to drive strategy, action, and decision-making with leaders across the business

• Align research priorities with business priorities and take a customer-focused mindset in working with stakeholders

• Lead the team's compensation analytics - the recurring, legally sensitive analyses that inform Total Rewards decisions on pay, compensation structure, and talent awards - in close partnership with Employment Legal and Total Rewards

• Lead design and measurement of Airbnb 's quality-of-hire metric with Recruiting, and own sensitive statutory and governance reporting

• Be a constant learner, active listener, and teacher to advance data science, people analytics, and Airbnb

• Use AI fluently - including the team's AirPanda platform and LLM-based agents - to accelerate analysis, prototyping, and synthesis, and to extend what a single researcher can deliver

Your Expertise:

• 5+ years in industry experience and a Master's degree/PhD in a quantitative field

• Deep experience with causal inference on observational data and quasi-experimental research design and analysis

• Proficiency in R or Python for statistical analysis, and SQL for data access

• Familiarity with survey design and analysis, as one of several methods in the toolkit

• Experience applying data science to compensation, recruiting, or broader workforce and organizational questions, including work with legally sensitive data

• Ability to communicate clearly and effectively to cross functional partners of varying technical levels and drive impact

• Experience working with large practical datasets

Your Location:
This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or att

title: Compliance Analyst - AML Investigations
description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles:  We Before Me , Do the Right Thing , and Get Things Done . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

The Compliance function at OKX is responsible for the overall compliance culture at the company. We're a team of risk-minded problem solvers who advise the business on the company's regulatory obligations and enterprise risk.

 

The successful candidate will have prior AML transaction monitoring and investigations experience in the financial services, FinTech or cryptocurrency industries. You will help detect unusual activity, suspicious/illegal behaviors and patterns, as well as assist in projects focused on preventing and detecting financial crimes.

 

As part of the AML Investigations team, you will be responsible for conducting a variety of tasks such as investigations, conducting enhanced due diligence, preparing narrative information for SAR filings, and participating in ad-hoc projects as needed. You will utilize internal and external investigative resources and apply logical research techniques.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Conduct thorough investigations on users' account activities as a result of transaction monitoring alerts.

• Where appropriate, collaborate cross-functionally in the investigation of transaction monitoring cases.

• Make determinations and recommend escalation decisions on cases investigated.

• Prepare SAR materials and draft SAR narratives.

• Conduct research using internal and external sources to help determine potentially suspicious activity and disposition of adverse news

• Create, update and maintain files and records related to all supporting information used during investigation.

• Assist with ad hoc projects incl. QA alert dispositions, validation of the transaction monitoring system or any updates, training, etc.

 

What We Look For In You 

•
3+ years experience in conducting AML-related account activity analysis, due diligence, and investigations in a financial services institution.

•
Strong writing, analytical and communications skills. Must be able to execute tasks within tight deadlines.

•
Strong interpersonal skills are necessary to work effectively with colleagues across regions and business units.

•
Should be a self-starter, organized, detail oriented, and results driven.

•
Excellent command of spoken and written English is required.

Nice to Haves

• Prior experience working in a multi-national or matrix environment.

• Knowledge with AML/CFT/Sanctions, money transmission regulations, and industry best practices.

• Familiarity with commonly used transaction monitoring & reporting tool(s), such as Chainalysis.

• Relevant industry certifications, e.g. CAMS.

• Cryptocurrency experience is a plus.

Competitive total compensation package

L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development

Wellness and meal allowances 

•
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

•
More that we love to tell you along the process!

We're looking for a Content Strategist who doesn't just create; they lead. Someone who sees the whole board: brand voice, channel performance, customer journey, and creative quality all at once. If you've always wanted to own a content function that actually moves business outcomes for real, recognizable brands, this role was built for you.
Why you’ll love it here:

• 🔥 High autonomy, high trust: We hire smart people and give them ownership. No micromanagement, no endless approvals, no corporate bureaucracy. You’ll have the freedom to test ideas, move fast, and turn insights into high-performing content.

• 📈 Performance-driven creativity: We care about storytelling, but we care just as much about engagement, conversions, and business impact. You’ll use performance data to guide decisions, optimize content, and scale what works.

• 🚀 Real influence on brand growth: Your ideas won’t sit in a deck collecting dust. You’ll help shape campaigns, messaging frameworks, creative direction, and content systems that directly contribute to growth.

• You think in strategy, not just tactics. You don’t ask “what should I post today?” - you ask “what does this brand need to achieve this quarter, and how does content help get us there?” You understand B2C buying psychology and how to move audiences from scroll to table.

• You know how to turn content into measurable growth. You lead content strategy across social media, email marketing, paid advertising, and websites, ensuring every touchpoint aligns with brand positioning, audience behaviour, and business goals.

• You write with intention. Your copy is clear, on-brand, and built to perform whether it’s a 3-word CTA for a Meta ad or a full email nurture sequence. You understand that tone is a strategy.

• You stay ahead of trends, platform behaviour, and cultural moments to create social strategies that feel relevant, engaging, and native to each platform.

• You know how to identify winning ideas and scale them. You use audience insights, performance data, and platform learnings to continuously optimize content across channels and formats.

• You own quality. Every piece of content that goes out under your watch reflects your standards. You review, refine, and push for better because you genuinely care about the work.

• You thrive in fast-moving, high-trust environments. We don’t micromanage. We set the direction, give you the tools, and trust you to execute.

• ✍️ Strong copywriting skills across social, email, ads, and short-form content.

• 📅 Experience managing content calendars and overseeing creative quality.

• Experience with restaurant, food & beverage, or hospitality brands.
